The real openssl: "builds" each build of a persona's release level in a container of its release (amd64 images; Raspberry Pi OS arm64; the EdgeOS and NAS326 programs from their firmware images under qemu-user; 2026-10-13), the CPUINFO line as "CPUINFO: -" (the CPU of the host); "images" list -commands and the prompt (stdin "version
foo
quit
") in containers of ubuntu:22.04, ubuntu:24.04, debian:12, debian:13, almalinux:9.4, almalinux:9.6, centos:7, debian:9 and debian:10 (arm64, 2026-10-13), each with the build of a persona that answers as it; list-standard-commands, list-message-digest-commands and list-cipher-commands in centos:7 with openssl-1.0.2k-26.el7_9 (arm64, 2026-10-21); help -help, help -h, help -foo, -help=1, help with two words and the list errors in ubuntu:22.04, ubuntu:24.04, debian:12, debian:13 (apt's openssl) and debian:9, debian:10 (archive.debian.org) (arm64, 2026-10-21). Not recorded, so not compared: list -help and the other options of list, which the persona answers as unknown ones. Texts longer than 200 characters are in "texts" ("@<id>").
